findings.title: The concurrent reader is not joined before asserting failures
findings.body: The test sets `deletedAll` and immediately asserts that `caughtExceptions` is empty, but the reader thread may already be inside `groups(...)` and can add an exception after this assertion has passed. This allows the regression test to pass even when the concurrent read fails, and leaves a live background thread running into subsequent test/realm cleanup. Signal the thread to stop, join it with a timeout, and only then assert the collected failures (and fail on timeout).
